changes.comment: Docs: add CAPABILITIES.md. @fgv/ts-random had no entry in LIBRARY_CAPABILITIES.md at all, so a consumer scanning for what fgv provides would conclude there was no seeded-random support. Documents the PRNG surface, the word/character corpora, and — load-bearing — that this is a mulberry32 PRNG and must never be used for tokens, salts or key material.
